propositions: Finding text longer than 240 characters is clipped mid-sentence without an ellipsis marker, leaving readers unable to detect that truncation occurred.
When more than 10 blocking findings exist, findings beyond the tenth are dropped silently with no count disclosure or "N more" note.
Review bot comments lack consistent truncation markers despite the codebase pattern established in voter.py:440 of explicitly marking omitted content.
Truncated findings can become unactionable because the clipped text may end mid-token, and undisclosed overflow reads as complete, violating the actionable-feedback contract.
Gerrit comment headers claim all blocking finding counts but the rendered bullets silently cap at 10 and clip details at 240 characters without indication.
